FrameworkTemplates.name: Nymbl Delivery
FrameworkTemplates.description: A detailed, execution-focused delivery framework emphasizing continuous progress tracking, demo-driven development, and operational readiness.

StageTemplates.name: Discovery
StageTemplates.description: Understand the problem space, constraints, stakeholders, and success criteria.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Project charter approved, key stakeholders identified
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Problem statement documented, success criteria defined, constraints cataloged

StageTemplates.name: Requirements
StageTemplates.description: Capture and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements aligned to demo outcomes.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Discovery phase complete, problem statement approved

StageTemplates.name: Design
StageTemplates.description: Define UX, system design, and technical architecture needed to support delivery.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Design artifacts approved, technical architecture finalized

StageTemplates.name: Development
StageTemplates.description: Implement features and capabilities in planned increments.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: All features implemented, unit tests passing, code reviewed

StageTemplates.name: QA
StageTemplates.description: Validate functionality, quality, and performance against requirements.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Development complete, build deployed to test environment
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: All critical defects resolved, UAT sign-off obtained

StageTemplates.name: Documentation
StageTemplates.description: Produce user, admin, and operational documentation to support delivery and adoption.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Features stable, QA in progress or complete

StageTemplates.name: Enable Users
StageTemplates.description: Train users, finalize support models, and prepare for go-live and handoff.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Users trained, support model activated, handoff complete

TaskTemplates.title: Conduct Stakeholder Interviews
TaskTemplates.description: Interview key stakeholders to understand their needs, pain points, and expectations for the project.

TaskTemplates.title: Analyze Current State
TaskTemplates.description: Document the existing processes, systems, and pain points to establish a baseline for improvement.

TaskTemplates.title: Define Problem Statement
TaskTemplates.description: Create a clear, concise problem statement that defines what needs to be solved.

TaskTemplates.title: Define Success Criteria
TaskTemplates.description: Establish measurable success criteria that will determine project completion and value delivery.

TaskTemplates.title: Identify Constraints and Risks
TaskTemplates.description: Document technical, resource, timeline, and budget constraints along with potential risks.

TaskTemplates.title: Document Functional Requirements
TaskTemplates.description: Capture detailed functional requirements describing what the system must do.

TaskTemplates.title: Document Non-Functional Requirements
TaskTemplates.description: Define performance, security, scalability, and other quality attributes.

TaskTemplates.title: Write User Stories
TaskTemplates.description: Create user stories with clear acceptance criteria for each feature.

TaskTemplates.title: Define Acceptance Criteria
TaskTemplates.description: Establish testable acceptance criteria for each requirement and user story.

TaskTemplates.title: Requirements Review and Sign-off
TaskTemplates.description: Conduct formal review of requirements with stakeholders and obtain approval.

TaskTemplates.title: Create UX Wireframes
TaskTemplates.description: Design low-fidelity wireframes showing layout and user flow.

TaskTemplates.title: Create UI Mockups
TaskTemplates.description: Develop high-fidelity visual designs and interactive prototypes.

TaskTemplates.title: Define System Architecture
TaskTemplates.description: Design the overall system architecture including components, integrations, and technology stack.

TaskTemplates.title: Design Data Model
TaskTemplates.description: Create the logical and physical data models for the solution.

TaskTemplates.title: Design Integrations
TaskTemplates.description: Define integration patterns, APIs, and data flows between systems.

TaskTemplates.title: Design Review and Approval
TaskTemplates.description: Conduct formal design review and obtain stakeholder approval.

TaskTemplates.title: Set Up Development Environment
TaskTemplates.description: Configure development, test, and staging environments.

TaskTemplates.title: Implement Feature
TaskTemplates.description: Develop the feature according to design specifications and coding standards.

TaskTemplates.title: Write Unit Tests
TaskTemplates.description: Create comprehensive unit tests to validate code functionality.

TaskTemplates.title: Conduct Code Review
TaskTemplates.description: Review code for quality, standards compliance, and best practices.

TaskTemplates.title: Integrate Components
TaskTemplates.description: Integrate developed components with other system parts and external systems.

TaskTemplates.title: Prepare Demo
TaskTemplates.description: Prepare and rehearse demo for stakeholder review of completed features.

TaskTemplates.title: Create Test Plan
TaskTemplates.description: Develop comprehensive test plan covering all testing types and scenarios.

TaskTemplates.title: Execute Functional Testing
TaskTemplates.description: Test all functional requirements and user stories.

TaskTemplates.title: Execute Regression Testing
TaskTemplates.description: Verify that new changes haven't broken existing functionality.

TaskTemplates.title: Execute Performance Testing
TaskTemplates.description: Test system performance, load handling, and scalability.

TaskTemplates.title: Conduct User Acceptance Testing
TaskTemplates.description: Facilitate and support UAT with business users.

TaskTemplates.title: Resolve Defects
TaskTemplates.description: Fix identified defects and verify resolutions.

TaskTemplates.title: Create User Guide
TaskTemplates.description: Write comprehensive end-user documentation with step-by-step instructions.

TaskTemplates.title: Create Admin Guide
TaskTemplates.description: Document system administration procedures and configuration options.

TaskTemplates.title: Create Operations Runbook
TaskTemplates.description: Document operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and incident response.

TaskTemplates.title: Create API Documentation
TaskTemplates.description: Document all APIs including endpoints, parameters, and examples.

TaskTemplates.title: Write Release Notes
TaskTemplates.description: Document new features, changes, and known issues for each release.

TaskTemplates.title: Develop Training Materials
TaskTemplates.description: Create training presentations, videos, and hands-on exercises.

TaskTemplates.title: Conduct User Training
TaskTemplates.description: Deliver training sessions to end users and super users.

TaskTemplates.title: Define Support Model
TaskTemplates.description: Establish support tiers, escalation paths, and SLAs.

TaskTemplates.title: Complete Go-Live Checklist
TaskTemplates.description: Verify all go-live prerequisites are met and obtain approval.

TaskTemplates.title: Complete Handoff
TaskTemplates.description: Transfer ownership to operations team with all necessary documentation and access.

TaskTemplates.title: Provide Hypercare Support
TaskTemplates.description: Provide intensive post-go-live support to address issues and questions.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Discovery Complete
MilestoneTemplates.description: Discovery phase completed with problem statement, success criteria, and constraints documented.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Requirements Baselined
MilestoneTemplates.description: All requirements documented, reviewed, and approved by stakeholders.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Design Approved
MilestoneTemplates.description: All design artifacts reviewed and approved, ready for development.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Feature Complete
MilestoneTemplates.description: All features implemented and unit tested, ready for QA.

MilestoneTemplates.name: QA Complete
MilestoneTemplates.description: All testing completed, defects resolved, UAT sign-off obtained.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Documentation Complete
MilestoneTemplates.description: All user, admin, and operational documentation published.

MilestoneTemplates.name: Go Live
MilestoneTemplates.description: System launched to production, users trained, support model active.
